verification_method: WebSearch + IBM official announcements + IBM docs feature table cross-check

substrate_match_to_sc_ref.primary_sc_ref_source: IBM Heron r2 fleet typical T2 = 100us
substrate_match_to_sc_ref.rationale: v3 explicitly uses same-substrate (Heron r2) T2 as the ratio denominator. This eliminates the v1/v2 cross-substrate fudge factor and the v2 unextractable PRNewswire reference.

honest_caveats: IBM has not publicly published per-qubit T2 averages for kingston specifically; estimates derive from fleet typicals + TLS-mitigation announcement.
Actual T2 at experiment time may drift; submit_ibm.py records backend.name + job_id for post-hoc calibration lookup via service.backend('ibm_kingston').properties().
Fallback path (least_busy operational Heron) means actual device may differ -- verifier records device name in results JSON.
